meta.purpose: Invented layout preview for Figure 7; not experimental evidence and no fabricated uncertainty intervals.
meta.layout: Double-column 1x4: (a,b) consecutive releases on the two Max models, (c,d) users returning after k skipped releases on Yambda-Max.
meta.anchors: Reuse and Rebuild AUC match the manuscript's synthetic Table 2.
meta.reset_arm: CacheTide (reset) restarts every release from the previous release's rebuilt cache with fresh correction state, i.e. one release of history. Its gap to the chained arm is accumulated error.
meta.skip_protocol: A fixed cohort has all requests and appends of k consecutive releases withheld before the target release V5; k=0 is an active user. Replay applies every intermediate update; composition applies Eq. 4.2 once.
meta.preparation_cost: Per-user state-preparation time at the first read after the target release, percent of Rebuild-on-first-read time for the same users.
